guidance.title: Before you start
guidance.onePerson: Only one person in the frame
guidance.faceVisible: Face clearly visible, nothing covering it
guidance.noSunglasses: Ask them to remove sunglasses and caps
guidance.lighting: Stand somewhere evenly lit — avoid strong backlight
guidance.distance: Fill about a third of the frame with their face
guidance.steady: Hold the phone steady so the photo isn't blurred
guidance.lightOnFace: Stand so the light falls on their face — never with the sun or a doorway behind them
guidance.openShade: Even, open shade works better than direct sun

quality.NO_FACE: We couldn't find a face in this photo.
quality.MULTIPLE_FACES: More than one face is in the frame. Ask others to step aside.
quality.FACE_TOO_SMALL: The face is too small. Move a little closer.
quality.TOO_BLURRY: The photo is blurred. Hold the phone steady and try again.
quality.TOO_DARK: The face is very dark. Move to better light if you can — but if the face looks clear on screen, go ahead.
quality.TOO_BRIGHT: There is too much glare on the face. Turn away from the bright light.
quality.EXTREME_ANGLE: The head is turned too far. Ask them to face the camera more.
quality.LOW_DETECTION_CONFIDENCE: We're not confident this is a clear face. Try again.
quality.LOW_FACE_DETAIL: There isn't enough detail in the face to work with. Move so the light falls on their face, not behind them.
quality.BACKLIT: The light is behind them. Turn around so their face is lit, or step into open shade.

face.needMore: Add {{count}} more usable photos before you can save.
face.consentBody: Face photos and the face templates made from them are sensitive personal data. They are used only to confirm identity at attendance. They are stored privately, never shared, and can be deleted at any time.
face.consentCheckbox: {{name}} has been told how their face data will be used and has agreed to it.
face.consentRequired: Please confirm consent before taking photos.
face.retentionNote: Photos are kept for {{days}} days, then deleted automatically.
face.deleteBody: This removes every face photo and face template for this driver. They'll need new photos before they can use the face scanner again. Attendance already recorded is not affected.
face.deleted: Face data for {{name}} has been deleted.
face.modelLoadFailed: The face scanner couldn't load. Check your connection, or record attendance by hand.

anomalies.title: Alerts
anomalies.subtitle: Check these trips and readings.

explanations.DISTANCE_VARIANCE_ABOVE: This trip covered {{observed}} km on a route that usually takes {{expected}} km — {{variance}}% more than expected.
explanations.DISTANCE_VARIANCE_BELOW: This trip covered {{observed}} km on a route that usually takes {{expected}} km — {{variance}}% less than expected.
explanations.ODOMETER_REGRESSION: The ending odometer ({{observed}} km) is lower than the starting one ({{expected}} km). That isn't possible, so one of the readings is wrong.
explanations.ODOMETER_IMPLAUSIBLE: The odometer suggests {{observed}} km in {{duration}} minutes, which works out at {{speed}} km/h.
explanations.RANGE_DROP: The dashboard range fell by {{observed}} km over {{distance}} km driven. This bus usually loses about {{expected}} km over the same distance. Range is the bus's own estimate, so treat this as a signal, not a measurement.
explanations.LOW_EFFICIENCY: This trip worked out at {{observed}} km/L against a usual {{expected}} km/L for this bus.
explanations.FUEL_DROP_WITHOUT_DISTANCE: The fuel gauge fell {{observed}} percentage points while the bus covered only {{distance}} km.
explanations.READING_CONFIDENCE: We weren't confident reading {{field}} from the dashboard photo.
explanations.READING_CORRECTION: The {{field}} reading was changed from {{expected}} to {{observed}} after the photo was taken.
explanations.MISSING_END_READING: This trip was finished without an end-of-trip dashboard reading.
explanations.DURATION_INCONSISTENT: The recorded time and the distance don't fit together.
explanations.DUPLICATE_CAPTURE: The same dashboard photo was submitted more than once for this bus.

privacy.title: How we handle face data
privacy.collectBody: Photographs of a driver's face taken during enrolment, and a mathematical template made from them.
privacy.useBody: Confirming who is driving when attendance is recorded. Nothing else. We do not estimate age, gender or emotion.
privacy.storeBody: In private storage that only your organisation's managers and administrators can reach. It is never published and never shared with other organisations.
privacy.retainBody: Photos are deleted automatically after {{days}} days. Templates are kept until the enrolment is removed.
privacy.rightsBody: A manager or administrator can delete a driver's face data at any time. Attendance already recorded stays, but the face data behind it is gone.
privacy.legalNote: Before using face recognition with real staff, check what your local privacy, employment and biometric-data rules require.
